URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/iran-says-peace-proposal-includes-reparations-war-damage-us-troop-withdrawal-2026-05-19/
TITLE: Trump says US may strike Iran again but that Tehran wants deal
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-19 07:29 (updated 2026-05-20 03:42)
AUTHORS: Humeyra Pamuk, Menna Alaaeldin
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY:
- Trump said Tuesday: US may need to strike Iran again
- Trump: "I was an hour away from making the decision to go today"
- Iran's leaders are "begging for a deal"
- New US attack would happen "in coming days if no agreement was reached"

VANCE (White House briefing Tuesday):
- "We're in a pretty good spot here"
- Acknowledged difficulty of negotiating with "fractured Iranian leadership"
- "It's not sometimes totally clear what the negotiating position of the team is"
- US trying to make own red lines clear
- One objective: prevent nuclear arms race spreading in region

IRAN'S POSITION:
- Ebrahim Azizi (Iranian parliament national security cmte head) on X: Trump's pausing of attack was due to realisation any move against Iran would mean "facing a decisive military response"
- "We will not submit to any threat"
- Iran's latest peace proposal (per Deputy FM Kazem Gharibabadi via IRNA):
  - End hostilities on all fronts incl Lebanon
  - Exit of US forces from areas close to Iran
  - Reparations for destruction from US-Israeli attacks
  - Lifting sanctions
  - Release of frozen funds
  - End to US marine blockade
- Terms "little changed from Iran's previous offer, which Trump rejected last week as 'garbage'"

US SEIZURE:
- US seized Iran-linked oil tanker Skywave in Indian Ocean overnight Tuesday (WSJ, 3 US officials)
- Sanctioned by US in March for role in transporting Iranian oil

CONTEXT:
- Indian rupee tumbled to record low (Reuters May 20 morning) as US-Iran stalemate stokes global inflation fears
- Brent crude fell to as low as $110.16 Tuesday before regaining most losses
- Chinese tankers exit Hormuz Wednesday (separate Reuters story)
- Pakistani source: both sides "keep changing their goalposts"; "We don't have much time"
